proposition: Ibn Turka's unswerving and impartial application of the Shariʿa in Yazd earned him enemies among the city's entrenched elite, who sent a delegation to Shāhrukh seeking his dismissal.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (829/1426), addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: the 'unswerving and impartial' motive is his own account of his enemies
